response:
It sounds incredibly exhausting and hurtful to be spoken to that way, especially by family. It is completely understandable that her harsh words are making you second-guess yourself, but remember that no one else has ever made these comments about you. Her reactions seem to reflect her own struggles with stress and control rather than your actual character.

Since open communication hasn't worked and only leads to more attacks, it might be time to set firm boundaries to protect your peace. You can limit the time you spend together or gently disengage when she becomes temperamental. You might say, "I want us to enjoy this visit, but I won't engage in this conversation if it turns into personal attacks." You are not obligated to absorb her frustration just because she is family. Trust your own knowledge of who you are, and prioritize your emotional well-being during the rest of her stay.
